WITH circuit_counts AS (
  SELECT circuitId, AVG(round) AS average_round, COUNT(*) AS race_count
  FROM races
  GROUP BY circuitId
)
SELECT circuitId,
       average_round,
       race_count,
       1.0 * race_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) AS share
FROM circuit_counts
ORDER BY share DESC
LIMIT 10;
